item.title: Europe’s biggest drone factory could be built near Budapest
item.description: After a multi-million euro investment, a Hungarian technology company is preparing to build what could become Europe’s largest drone manufacturing facility.

item.title: Weather in Hungary: Snow, fog, and double front
item.description: Cold and warm fronts will influence the weather in Hungary at the same time.

item.title: Shocking: Man grabbed an axe and chased Tisza Party activists
item.description: According to Tisza Party leader Péter Magyar, the attack took place in a housing estate in Debrecen while two young volunteers were door-knocking.

item.title: Hungarian minority politician detained in Slovakia during protest for disagreeing with anti-Hungarian laws
item.description: Örs Orosz, Hungarian minority politician in Slovakia was escorted away by police after he refused to remove a high-visibility vest bearing the slogan “We question the Beneš decrees.”

item.title: PM Orbán called Roma protesters at a public forum “organised criminals”
item.description: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has described Roma protesters who disrupted a public forum held by Transport Minister János Lázár as “organised criminals”. Lázár later published a video of them, with their alleged crimes.

item.title: Hungary reports new fatal case linked to alleged forced conscription in Ukraine
item.description: Hungary’s FM, Péter Szijjártó, has claimed that another Hungarian citizen has died as a result of what he described as forced military conscription in Ukraine.

item.title: Are you the missing Hungarian heir to a fortune from Canada? Lawyers are looking for the answer
item.description: It sounds like the plot of a movie, but a Canadian law firm is searching for a Hungarian woman who may be entitled to a substantial inheritance left behind by a relative, who emigrated to Canada decades ago.

item.title: Budapest is one of the top 3 cities of Europe for filming
item.description: Budapest has once again confirmed its status as one of Europe’s most attractive filming destinations, after being ranked third in a new industry-focused list of the continent’s top 20 cities worth filming in.

item.title: Exclusive video: Hungarian-speaking Ukrainian POW appeals for help as volunteer group Mothers’ Shield seeks publicity
item.description: A Hungarian-speaking POW has appeared in a newly released video asking for help. A Ukrainian volunteer group says publicity could support his case in a future prisoner exchange. Here’s what we know.
